K_verdict.rule: COMPILER DEFECT if A and H ever disagree or the refinement splits an orbit; NO SEPARATION IN SCOPE if Phase S found none; SEPARATION AND VALUE if every criterion below holds; otherwise SEPARATION WITHOUT DEMONSTRATED VALUE. Frozen in the preregistration before the sweep
K_verdict.why: a preregistered fixture family yielded Q_ref != Q_aut; the exact distinctions carry target-relevant information, measured as a strictly positive irreducible floor for the refinement compiler against zero for the exact one; and the exact compiler's asymptotic advantage is observed inside the tested grid and does not reverse

2000 replicates, the 0.02 threshold, and the stays-ahead definition of the crossover

conditions.name: A
conditions.role: exact automorphism compiler: one observable scalar per Q_aut cell

conditions.name: H
conditions.role: handed exact oracle: Q_aut cell membership read out of the byte-pinned Phase S certificate by a path that never calls a compiler

conditions.name: R
conditions.role: refinement compiler: one observable scalar per Q_ref cell

conditions.name: S
conditions.role: saturated ablation: one observable scalar per admitted input

conditions.name: W
conditions.role: falsification control: a partition with the Q_aut cardinalities that respects no derived structure-preserving map

falsification_control.construction: move the 4 lexicographically least members of each exact cell into the next cell cyclically, preserving every cardinality

regimes.A: uniform over every admitted input, train and evaluate
regimes.B: hold out whole identities stratified by Q_aut cell

design.uncompiled_learners: deliberately absent. Section 9 makes them secondary and the main comparison compiler-versus-compiler; 017.27 measured the compiled-against-uncompiled axis on two other worlds and nothing here disturbs it

prediction_validation.method: the exact expectation must lie within four standard errors of the simulated mean for every condition in every regime A cell; the standard error is recovered from the reported confidence interval so the check is reproducible from the artifact alone
